messages:
sara: created RC rc-2026.03.19-1753 from branch release/feature-routing. Pin request: artifact sha b3f7a9e. Target promo window 20:00 UTC, requesting ops + QA signoff.

deploybot: automated: RC created: rc-2026.03.19-1753 (artifact b3f7a9e). Scheduled promo window 20:00 UTC. Canary strategy: 10% -> 50% -> 100% unless abort.

aaron: starting quick smoke run now. will post results.

maria: quick heads up — smoke shows a console warning in routing lib, not blocking but will dig in.

jen: can we set an abort gate: telemetry ingestion lag > 2s or error increase > 0.5%?

oncall-sheriff: +1 to explicit abort criteria. propose: error rate >1% for 15m OR 95p latency > 600ms = abort and rollback.

aar on: smoke results: no errors, 95p latency 210ms.

maria: verified the warning; it's a harmless deprecation from 3rd-party dependency. not a blocker.

sara: product signoff requested for release notes + migration note. also need a pinned artifact in the internal registry before promo.

release-coach-bot: checklist reminder: attach changelog, confirm no DB migrations, pin artifact with `repo pin` command, and add runbook excerpt. Example:
```
repo pin rc-2026.03.19-1753 b3f7a9e --env prod
```

aaron: pinned artifact in registry: registry.internal.redwood/rc-2026.03.19-1753 -> b3f7a9e :thumbsup:.

deploybot: scheduled promo at 20:00 UTC. Canary plan set.

sara: backup rollback plan: fallback to stable@2026.03.05-1122 with traffic-shim + kv-evict; runbook updated.

oncall-sheriff: confirm abort criteria again and that someone is standing by to execute rollback. jen, can you be on the hook?

jen: yep, I'll be on standby at promo time and ready to execute rollback if abort triggers.

maria: adding release note draft: "Routing fallback improvements; improved cache warm; no DB schema changes. KV warm enabled by default." will drop into release-notes doc.

aaron: pre-promo checklist done: DB connections drained, no migrations, feature-flag left off for quick rollback. KV warm toggle set.

deploybot: canary deploy started 20:00:10 UTC -> 10% traffic.

aar on: monitoring dashboards — 5m checks green. No error uplift.

oncall-sheriff: metrics look good, authorize ramp to 50% after 30m unless anything flares.

deploybot: scheduled ramp to 50% at 20:30 UTC.

sara: product ack via product channel (confirmed by @mike). proceeding.

jen: post-promo watch for 60m, I'll take first 30m then hand off to ops.

maria: noticed a tiny spike at 20:39 — traced to missing cache-control header in one route. non-user-facing. pushing quick patch to canary now.

deploybot: patch promoted to canary, adjusted headers. Canary remains healthy.

aar on: after 15m of green post-patch, recommend continue ramp to 100%.

deploybot: ramping to 100% starting 20:50 UTC.

deploybot: promo complete at 20:52:34 UTC -> rc-2026.03.19-1753 at 100% traffic.

sara: finalizing release notes and updating docs with the rollback steps and runbook link. closing the promo thread after watch window. great job all! :tada:

oncall-sheriff: excellent. please ensure rollback steps are in the runbook (I pasted them into /runbooks/releases/rc_rollbacks.md). we'll keep watch for 60m then mark stable.

release-coach-bot: reminder logged: post-promo retro in #eng-releases tomorrow 10:00 UTC to capture learnings.

sara: thanks team. marking thread resolved.
